inline_text:
### Project Name
kdeps

### Project Description
kdeps is an open-source AI Appliance Builder written in Go. You define AI agents and workflows in YAML and ship them as a Docker image, Kubernetes deployment or standalone binary. It runs local models (Ollama, llamafile/GGUF) and cloud LLMs through langchaingo, and includes an MCP tools client. It was created in August 2024 by Joel Bryan Juliano, a self-taught engineer with 20+ years of experience, and is maintained by kdeps (Dutch company, KvK 94834768). The current release is v2.63.0.

### Preferred Lifecycle Stage (if known)
Sandbox

### Alignment with AAIF Mission
kdeps gives teams a vendor-neutral, declarative way to package and run agents, including fully on-prem and air-gapped setups for regulated organisations. That supports AAIF's goal of open, interoperable infrastructure for agentic systems.

### Relation to Existing AAIF Projects
- MCP: kdeps ships an MCP tools client (`pkg/tools/mcp`, `examples/mcp-tools`).
- AGENTS.md: the agent collects AI instruction files, including AGENTS.md, alongside KDEPS.md, CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md (`pkg/agent/instructions.go`).
- goose: no integration today.

### Example Use Cases and Evidence of Adoption
- Belastingdienst (Dutch Tax and Customs Administration): user (production use).
- Randstad Digital: user.

### Technical Committee Sponsor (if identified)
None identified yet

### GitHub Repository URL
https://github.com/kdeps/kdeps

### License
Apache-2.0

### Governance Model
Maintainer-led, documented in https://github.com/kdeps/kdeps/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md. Maintainers review and merge; schema, CLI and execution-model changes require a tracking issue.

### CI/CD & Release Workflow
GitHub Actions (tests, golangci-lint, CodeQL, Trivy, codecov) and GoReleaser. Semver releases plus daily nightly tags. Dependabot keeps dependencies up to date.

### Public-Facing Contribution Process for Specifications
https://github.com/kdeps/kdeps/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md. Changes to the workflow.yaml schema need a tracking issue and maintainer approval; discussion happens in GitHub Discussions (https://github.com/kdeps/kdeps/discussions).

### Publicly Accessible Issue Tracker
https://github.com/kdeps/kdeps/issues

### External Project Dependencies
Main direct dependencies: tmc/langchaingo (MIT), spf13/cobra (Apache-2.0), moby client (Apache-2.0), mattn/go-sqlite3 (MIT), lib/pq (MIT), go-sql-driver/mysql (MPL-2.0), mongo-go-driver (Apache-2.0), playwright-go (MIT), charmbracelet libraries (MIT), yaml.v3 (MIT/Apache-2.0).

### Maintainers & Contributors
- Joel Bryan Juliano (@jjuliano), kdeps, sole active maintainer. Activity: https://github.com/kdeps/kdeps/commits?author=jjuliano
- Herald Jane Juliano, kdeps, business administration (not a code maintainer).
We are actively looking for maintainers from other organisations.

### Leadership Team & Decision Process
Joel Bryan Juliano (maintainer and founder) leads. Decisions follow GOVERNANCE.md: lazy consensus for routine changes, and a tracking issue with public discussion for schema/CLI changes.

### Lifecycle Stage Evidence
Sandbox: working implementation (v2.63.0), used by the Belastingdienst and Randstad Digital, and an active named maintainer. Intended users: platform and engineering teams, especially in regulated or air-gapped environments, who need to package and run agents declaratively. Growth graduation would be justified by additional maintainers from other organisations and broader adoption.

Roadmap summary: hardening the MCP tools client, exploring an MCP server mode, simplifying the CLI (merging packaging commands, trimming niche providers), and broadening the maintainer base. Governance: https://github.com/kdeps/kdeps/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
